marketLayer.title: US Big Tech AI Infrastructure Capex
marketLayer.fact: Major US technology conglomerates reported elevated Q2 capital expenditures dedicated to AI data centers, spurring orders for advanced hardware manufacturers.
marketLayer.inference: Short-term margin compression may affect hyperscalers, while providing strong revenue tailwinds for semiconductor and hardware supply chains across US and Asian markets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Monetization timeline for enterprise AI software applications relative to ongoing infrastructure spending.

marketLayer.title: Hang Seng Tech Index & Chinese Internet Stocks
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index closed higher following better-than-expected cloud service growth and advertising revenue reported by major Chinese platform companies.
marketLayer.inference: Valuation rerate expected for oversold internet blue-chips, boosting Southbound capital inflows through the Stock Connect program.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of domestic consumer sentiment recovery and potential secondary impacts from international trade policies.

marketLayer.title: Fed Rate Cut Expectations & HK Financial Sector
marketLayer.fact: Cooling US inflation metrics increased market consensus for an upcoming Federal Reserve rate reduction, easing pressure on Hong Kong interbank offered rates (HIBOR).
marketLayer.inference: Lower interest rate environment reduces borrowing costs for HK-listed property developers and high-dividend plays, while potentially dampening net interest margins for local banks.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Volatility in global energy prices threatening the disinflation trajectory before the next FOMC meeting.
